#0 background — blackboard-dark; ψ brightening (offense becoming inquiry); ✎ → 1948 stages the record's own distinction — Fierz's undated typescript against the later 60P dating; attract/pulse gentle; no automation (the interval before the dream).

#1 self-division — the egg disc walks from centre to the second position (one has become two, each still an egg); '' → ⬮⬮ marks the plurality; the motion quiet (pointerStrength 0.25) — this happens without the dreamer; no automation.

#2 the hand — THE 3D SCENE. z is the dreamer's approach: the spontaneous pair deepest (⬮⬮ at z −0.3), the blue egg at z −0.05 brightening (noticed), ⬮ → ⬮⬮ the division that keeps wholeness at z +0.15, ✦ the marvel at z +0.25, the dreamer ◉ nearest at z +0.35; attract/implode — the approach gathering; the record's space 'enacted by arrival, approach and the discovery of something already in the hand' staged as depth.
#3 quotient — cos sin → cos±i·sin: four displayed terms becoming one relation retaining opposing signs; ± held at the rim; vortex/pulse faint — the turning of the relation.
#4 circle — e^{iδ} → ○: the formula vanishes and the circle appears, with the unit-circle ring brightening in step; ❝ the first speech; ∅⁺ no eighth scene; attract/pulse — the naming settling.
#5 commentary — ⬮⬮ → ⬮⬮⬮⬮: the two pairs with two different origins completing the quaternion; ◉✂ the intervention; i the imaginary office; ∅ the refused finished interpretation; vortex/pulse faint.

#6 return — ring layout: the circle brightening (exact in its own scope), ⬮⬮⬮⬮ the four eggs with two origins retained beneath it; X/x and A19 keep the authorial offices (human-amplified guards in view); attract/pulse — the recovered telling received.

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 opened with concepts arriving unbidden (ψ dim, an undated note); #6 returns to the circle the dreamer named — the seven pictures' cardinality and the four eggs' two origins retained beneath it, the spontaneous first division of #1 now readable beside the participated division of #2 without being absorbed into one origin. The dream's space began as arrival/approach/discovery and ends as a circle exact in its own scope: what entered unbidden is received consciously, and the telling refuses both the eighth scene and the finished interpretation.

Human-amplified guards carried (relation-local): human-amplified: yes for the whole-before-fragments programme office only; no new symbolic identity ratified; X/x Taylor's, not the dream's; the Maria Prophetissa axiom his comparison via Jung, not verified ancient attribution; a faster process is not more conscious (distinction kept in the record, trimmed from the scene body for the word floor); no shell-to-function assignment; no egg-to-stage or egg-to-QL map (human-amplified: no); the exact separate Taylor egg-specific commentary remains an authorial-carrier debt. Mythemic verbs only: the dream displays spontaneous division and participated division; the commentary demonstrates conscious participation.

Automation: auto-angle on #4's circulation — 'as the angle varies it describes the circle': the one lane the record itself licenses; elsewhere the sequence-clocks carry the beats (division, naming, appearing) and the pictures are held still, as a dream sequence holds; durations 12–14, transitions 1.3–1.6 with distinct beats; #2 and #3 held longest (the approach and the relation).

Rework craft 2026-10-07 (zcode craft lane 2): Redrawn as the dream's own seven pictures: the drawn egg divides itself in sequence states before any intervention; the blue scene (3D) draws the cupped hand holding the blue egg and the pair that stays whole; pictures 5–6 are drawn as the matrix and the conjugate quotient fraction beside the unjoined egg-and-wave; picture 7 performs the replacement — a text entity speaks e^{iδ} and its sequence leaves a standing ring on the journey's one light ground; commentary draws the noticing eye, the scissors, the raised hand of refusal; the return draws the four eggs of two origins inside the final ring and the observer framed inside the operation. Colour journey: study night held across background and first pictures (still pair) → the blue of the shell → slate of the expressions → the light of the circle → late night held across commentary and return (still pair). Stage text seven title/italic pairs, no metadata; internal route codes off the stage.

glyph_rationales.the dreamer — Pauli, after the Kepler wo: the drawn figure at his desk — the physicist receiving his own disciplinary language in a mode he did not choose.
glyph_rationales.ψ: background physics — physical concepts arriving spontaneously in dreams, in a qualitative, symbolic sense.
glyph_rationales.the companion dream — brass tones engrav: the drawn plate with its engraved waves — the Göttingen dream of the hydrogen ground state's change, announced in brass tones.
glyph_rationales.Fierz's note — an undated typescript, an: the drawn typed page — Fierz's characterisation of the surviving typescript.
glyph_rationales.the woman with the bird — unnamed; their: the drawn figure with a bird at her shoulder — the unnamed arrival through which the egg enters the dream.
glyph_rationales.picture 1 — the single egg, awaiting wha: the drawn egg outline — one thing, its enclosing form still whole.
glyph_rationales.picture 2 — the egg divides itself, with: two drawn states — one egg, then two complete outlines; the division occurs before any intervention, and each remains an egg.
glyph_rationales.≠: no good egg and evil egg — no conflict between the two; the dream makes plurality, not moral opposition.
glyph_rationales.pictures 1–2 — the spontaneous pair abov: the small drawn pair — the eggs that divided themselves, retained above the scene of his hand.
glyph_rationales.picture 3 — the blue-shelled egg already: the drawn egg over a cupped hand — what approach reveals: a third egg already held, not manufactured.
glyph_rationales.picture 4 — divided by him, both remain: the drawn pair of blue eggs — his division, the marvel that wholeness survives it: two eggs, not two broken portions.
glyph_rationales.✦: the marvel — preservation through division, the point his commentary concentrates on.
glyph_rationales.the dreamer — approaches, notices, parti: the small standing figure at the scene's edge — the observer entering what he first only received.
glyph_rationales.picture 5 — four expressions in two rows: the drawn matrix of cos and sin — the four eggs become four expressions, the paired arrangement kept in a new medium.
glyph_rationales.picture 6 — the conjugate quotient, modu: the drawn fraction — [cos+i·sin]/[cos−i·sin]: the cosine unchanged, the imaginary sine term changing sign; one relation retaining opposing signs.
glyph_rationales.no shell-to-function assignment added —: the drawn egg beside a wave with no arrow between — the source assigns no shell colour to any function, so none is added.
glyph_rationales.±: the opposing signs retained in one relation — the ± of the conjugate pair.
glyph_rationales.formula → circle — the dream's own repla: the sequence speaks the expression e^{iδ}, then the formula vanishes and a circle stands in its place — speech entering at the end.
glyph_rationales.e^{iδ}: the spoken recognition — Pauli's identification of the quotient with the exponential.
glyph_rationales.a point for fixed angle, the circle as t: the small disc on the ring — the exact scope: a point for fixed angle, the circle as the locus.
glyph_rationales.❝: the dreamer's first speech — quotation entering a silent picture sequence.
glyph_rationales.seven pictures, complete — no eighth sce: seven ticks and a stop — the sequence's count and its completion; nothing reported after the circle.
glyph_rationales.the ground state — the spontaneous pair: the drawn pair — Pauli's reading of the first division as a ground state.
glyph_rationales.the noticing eye — attention as the firs: the drawn eye — conscious participation begins as noticing what is already held.
glyph_rationales.✂: the dividing act — intervention on what he holds, distinct from the egg's self-division.
glyph_rationales.i: the imaginary unit's symbolic office — its introduction lets the paired opposites combine into the form he reads as wholeness.
glyph_rationales.the refusal — further progress in the sc: the drawn raised hand — his refusal of a finished interpretation; the limit left standing.
glyph_rationales.Neumann's round compared — no egg-to-sta: the faint ring — the round-differentiation comparison kept as comparison; no egg assigned to any stage.
glyph_rationales.the circle — the dream's end, exact in i: the wide ring — the image the naming leaves standing: exact as mathematics, open as meaning.
glyph_rationales.the four eggs with two different origins: four drawn eggs, two marked differently — the spontaneous pair and the consciously divided pair keep their distinct histories.
glyph_rationales.X/x: Taylor's native notation — the seven pictures and four eggs count no eightfold; the cardinalities differ and no appointment is forced.
glyph_rationales.the observer inside the operation — A19': a drawn frame with the figure inside it — the observer brought into the operation he first receives (A19).
